name: fridgefit-functions
description: FridgeFit Cloud Functions: server-side account deletion.

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-fridgefit --only auth,firestore,functions 'node --test functions/test/deletion.e2e.test.mjs'
scripts.test:e2e:stale: npm run build && cd .. && DELETION_MAX_AUTH_AGE_SECONDS=0 firebase emulators:exec --project demo-fridgefit --only auth,firestore,functions 'DELETION_MAX_AUTH_AGE_SECONDS=0 node --test functions/test/staleAuth.e2e.test.mjs'
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:stale
